content:
Sometimes a small change can make a big difference. For users with a large amount of pre-release software, Apple's latest TestFlight update is especially the case.

Apple has just updated TestFlight for iPhone, iPad, Mac and other devices. The new version 4.3 adds a 'search bar for quickly finding applications'.

Comparing it with version 4.2.2, you can clearly see that TestFlight has now added a search bar at the bottom of the iPhone and at the top of the Mac sidebar.

If you only have a few pre-release apps, you may find this change very basic, but for users with a bunch of beta apps, the search function has been a long-awaited feature.

This update also allows the 'Previously Tested' category to show more applications, so the usual bug fixes and performance improvements may be related to this aspect.

Apple's TestFlight app is available for download on the App Store, supporting iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro and Apple TV.
